name: Clinical missense variant pathogenicity classification
description: Separate pathogenic from benign human missense variants using clinical labels such as ClinVar, scored by AUROC or a similar ranking metric.

attributes.scope_note: Evaluated by Brandes et al. 2023 (ClinVar and HGMD/gnomAD missense benchmarks), the ProteinGym clinical substitutions track and the Livesey and Marsh 2025 clinical benchmark. The label sets, variant filters and metrics differ between them; they share the prediction question, not a protocol.

name: Zero-shot fitness prediction on RNAGym ncRNA DMS assays
description: Rank variant fitness within the RNAGym non-coding RNA deep mutational scanning assays without training on them, scored by correlation with the measured fitness.

attributes.task: Zero-shot fitness prediction on RNAGym ncRNA DMS assays
attributes.scope_note: Evaluated by the RNAGym fitness leaderboard and by Wang et al. 2026 on the same 31 ncRNA assays. The leaderboard reports signed Spearman and Wang reports absolute Spearman (SR), AUC and MCC, so values are not directly interchangeable.
